name: Kippy Amy Zacher (Becker)
notable_stories: Pursued a BA in Nursing from WSU while working at Kennewick General Hospital
milestones: Born 24 Nov 1974, Kadlec Hospital, Richland, Washington
education: Kippy was due to graduate from the WSU Nursing Program in May 2011 with a BA in Nursing, after earlier earning Certified Nursing Assistant credentials.
career: Kippy had worked at Kennewick General Hospital for seven years as of 2011. (abt 2004-2011)
sources: Family research emails, 2011–2013 (John and Barbara Adams with Irma Kulp Zacher, George F. Adams, Bill Allen and others)
notes: Siblings listed: Kimberly, Kenneth. Child of Irmagene Kulp Zacher.
